title: not so much X as Y
pattern: not so much X as Y
meaningEn: corrective emphasis rather than absolute exclusion
explanation: not so much X as Y revises the most useful description of something: X may remain partly true, but Y receives explanatory weight. 并非一律完全否定X，也不是比较两个数字。X和Y应尽量语法平行：名词对名词、动名词对动名词、从句对从句。它可引导对原因、责任或价值的细致重估，适合论说和批评；若只是“更喜欢A”，不必套用这个纠正性结构。
usage: 修正表面标签，把论证的重点移到更准确的框架。
nuance: 与not X but Y相比，not so much通常容许X部分成立；后文证据须支持Y，不能靠句式装深刻。
structure: not so much + parallel X + as + parallel Y
X和Y可为名词、动名词或完整从句
formation: not so much + parallel X + as + parallel Y
X和Y可为名词、动名词或完整从句

examples.target: The problem is not so much a lack of space as a lack of access.
examples.zh: 问题与其说是空间不足，不如说是缺乏使用渠道。

examples.target: She was not so much refusing the proposal as asking who would bear the cost.
examples.zh: 她与其说在拒绝提案，不如说在问谁承担费用。

examples.target: The archive preserves not so much a final verdict as a record of disagreement.
examples.zh: 档案保留的与其说是最终裁决，不如说是分歧记录。

examples.target: What changed was not so much the evidence as the questions put to it.
examples.zh: 变化的与其说是证据，不如说是人们向证据提出的问题。

notes: 课程等级为教学编排，不是官方穷尽式分类。
开放题采用参考答案和学习者确认，不声称自动语义评分。

commonMistakes.wrong: Intended parallel nouns: It is not so much a lack of time as to organise the work.
commonMistakes.correct: It is not so much a lack of time as a failure to organise the work.
commonMistakes.explanation: 比较项需平行；将第二项改为名词短语，且它应符合实际证据。

comparison.explanation: no more X than Y可借显然不成立的Y否定X；not so much X as Y重新分配解释重点，不必把X彻底排除。

exercises.prompt: 理解完整例句：The problem is not so much a lack of space as a lack of access.
options: 问题与其说是空间不足，不如说是缺乏使用渠道。
空间本身一定完全充足，人人均可使用。
访问权限与空间必然是同一个概念。
acceptedAnswers: 问题与其说是空间不足，不如说是缺乏使用渠道。
exercises.explanation: not so much X as Y revises the most useful description of something: X may remain partly true, but Y receives explanatory weight. 并非一律完全否定X，也不是比较两个数字。X和Y应尽量语法平行：名词对名词、动名词对动名词、从句对从句。它可引导对原因、责任或价值的细致重估，适合论说和批评；若只是“更喜欢A”，不必套用这个纠正性结构。

exercises.prompt: A contrast between gerunds: She was not so much rejecting it as (　) its assumptions.
exercises.explanation: rejecting和questioning是平行动名词/分词短语，此处共同跟随was。

exercises.prompt: Does “not so much a final verdict as a record of disagreement” erase every conclusion in the archive?
options: Yes; disagreement means no evidence exists.
No; it reframes the archive’s main value without excluding every conclusion.
Yes; any conclusion would contradict the sentence.
acceptedAnswers: No; it reframes the archive’s main value without excluding every conclusion.
exercises.explanation: not so much reallocates emphasis; it does not quantify or absolutely negate every instance of X.

exercises.prompt: 按本课要求纠正并对照解析：Intended parallel nouns: It is not so much a lack of time as to organise the work.
acceptedAnswers: It is not so much a lack of time as a failure to organise the work.
exercises.explanation: 比较项需平行；将第二项改为名词短语，且它应符合实际证据。

exercises.prompt: 参考本课表达译成目标语言：变化的与其说是证据，不如说是人们向证据提出的问题。
acceptedAnswers: What changed was not so much the evidence as the questions put to it.
